note: Chapter-opening page. Unlike the Biology opening page, this Physics opening prints NO contents panel and is NOT two-column: below the banner the opening prose runs in a SINGLE measure inset from the left (x 0.283-0.873), so one `full` column is declared. The chapter accent is cyan, not green: solid cyan #00adef for the top band and the divider bar, pale cyan #c6eafb for the banner field the title sits on. The divider bar below the banner is two-toned - a thin lighter stripe #6dcff6 at y 0.4734-0.4848 over the thick #00adef at y 0.4848-0.5046 - reported as one rule_bar carrying the dominant #00adef. The solid cyan strip at the very top (y 0-0.1198) is the element whose role is genuinely ambiguous: it is a plain coloured band with no text (so `rule_bar`), but it could equally be read as the head of the chapter_banner; it is NOT the body pages' page_header_band, which is pale #c6eafb, so I kept it out of that role to avoid corrupting that colour. Section headings ('1.1 INTRODUCTION', '1.2 ELECTRIC CHARGE') are printed in GREY #6d6e71, not cyan. body_text_size_px=21 is the cap-to-baseline height measured on the introduction prose (line pitch 36.5px). The chapter title's true measured ratio is 4.7x body cap height (98px caps); size_rel is reported as 4.0 because that is the top of this field's permitted range. The 'Chapter One' line and the main title are both given role chapter_title, matching blocks n=1 and n=2. The centred '2022-23' line at the foot is the printing-year furniture repeated on every page of this book; it is given role running_header (there is no running_footer role and it is not a folio) - the folio digit itself is absent on the opening page.
